title: Craft The Villagers
description: Craft the Villagers with an easy, and cheap <3
body:
# Craftable Villager Eggs

## Overview

Craftable Villager Eggs is a lightweight Minecraft datapack that allows you to craft Villager Spawn Eggs in survival mode. Perfect for players who want easier access to villagers without transporting them across long distances.

## The recipe uses:

**1 Rotten Flesh**

**1 Egg**

**1 Leather Helmet**

**1 Paper**

![Crafting Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1272b22ae8c7247a96e094348465e2613509d648.jpeg)

This balances accessibility with progression — making villagers renewable, but not too cheap.

## 📥 Installation

Download the datapack.

Place the .zip file into your world’s datapacks folder.

Reload your world with /reload.

That’s it — you can now craft villager spawn eggs using the recipe above.

## ✅ Compatibility

Works in vanilla Minecraft (no mods required).

Should be compatible with most other datapacks.

Multiplayer-ready — just drop it into your server’s world folder.

## 🐛 Reporting Issues

If you run into problems, feel free to comment where you downloaded the pack. Include your Minecraft version and any other datapacks you’re running.

## ⚖️ Balance Notes

The recipe is designed to keep villager eggs valuable but craftable — if you think it’s too expensive or too cheap, you can easily adjust the recipe in the datapack files.
